IF DB_ID('EcommerceWarehouse') IS NULL
BEGIN
    CREATE DATABASE EcommerceWarehouse;
END;

USE EcommerceWarehouse

CREATE EXTERNAL DATA SOURCE EcommerceGold
WITH
(
    LOCATION = 'https://stcommercesrc.dfs.core.windows.net/gold'
);


CREATE EXTERNAL FILE FORMAT ParquetFormat
WITH
(
    FORMAT_TYPE = PARQUET
);

SELECT DB_NAME() AS current_database;

SELECT
    DB_NAME() AS current_database,
    name,
    location
FROM sys.external_data_sources
WHERE name = 'EcommerceGold';


SELECT name
FROM sys.databases
WHERE name = 'EcommerceWarehouse';





SELECT 'customer_360' AS table_name,
       COUNT_BIG(*) AS total_rows
FROM dbo.customer_360

UNION ALL

SELECT 'customer_segmentation',
       COUNT_BIG(*)
FROM dbo.customer_segmentation

UNION ALL

SELECT 'daily_sales',
       COUNT_BIG(*)
FROM dbo.daily_sales

UNION ALL

SELECT 'product_performance',
       COUNT_BIG(*)
FROM dbo.product_performance

UNION ALL

SELECT 'regional_sales',
       COUNT_BIG(*)
FROM dbo.regional_sales;
